gloss: to shut oneself in; to be filled with; to be muffled

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {籠|こ}もっていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to shut oneself in; to seclude oneself; to stay indoors
definitions.explanation: To withdraw into a room, house, or other space and not come out. Often implies focusing intensely on something or avoiding the outside world.

definitions.gloss: to be filled with; to contain; to be imbued with
definitions.explanation: For a space or thing to be filled with something (heat, smoke, emotions, etc.).

definitions.gloss: to be muffled; to be stuffy
definitions.explanation: For sound or air to be trapped and not escape properly.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: Intransitive verb (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧).

CONJUGATION: Godan verb (-る type)
- {籠|こ}もらない (negative)
- {籠|こ}もります (polite)
- {籠|こ}もって (te-form)
- {籠|こ}もった (past)

WRITING:
Can be written as {籠|こ}もる or {篭|こ}もる. Also commonly written in hiragana.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{籠|こ}もる - to shut oneself in a room
- ⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{籠|こ}もる - to stay at home
- ⟦{思|おも}い→思い：10248_omoi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{籠|こ}もった - filled with feeling/emotion
- {気持|きも}ち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{籠|こ}もる - to be filled with feeling
- ⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{籠|こ}もる - voice becomes muffled

MODERN USAGE:
{引|ひ}き{籠|こ}もり (hikikomori) - social withdrawal/recluse - is derived from this verb.

REGISTER:
Neutral. Common in everyday conversation and writing.
